clue.text: Study in group for preference with absolutely endless entry (Collins)

indicators.note: the word in tells us the study word sits inside the group word

parts.note: a band is a group of musicians
to read a subject is to study it at university

indicators.note: with ... entry means the trimmed absolutely word makes its way into the preference word

parts.note: better, as in 'I'd better', expresses what is preferred

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the synonym for absolutely is cut off

parts.note: utterly means absolutely, completely

explanation.surface: Someone studies in a group, preferring an entry that is absolutely endless, with a nod to Collins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Collins' looks like a mere attribution in brackets, but it is the definition: Chambers lists a collins as a thank-you note, after Mr Collins in Pride and Prejudice, who writes one after his visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Chambers records 'collins' as a name for the courtesy thank-you note a guest sends after a stay.

clue.text: Lauren carrying king's child: he was starting from a desperate position

indicators.note: carrying means the actress's surname holds the following pieces within it

parts.note: Lauren Bacall was the Hollywood actress
K is the chess abbreviation for king, with the possessive S
a tot is a small child
taken as written

indicators.note: starting means only the opening letter of the word was is used

explanation.surface: Lauren Bacall, pregnant with a royal baby, began from a hopeless situation.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes being cornered with no room to retreat, a hopeless predicament.

clue.text: Shifty sort of action

definitions.meaning: shifty describes someone dodging questions, not straightforward
a pilot or driver takes this kind of action to swerve away from danger

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share the idea of dodging: a dodgy manner and a manoeuvre to avoid a hazard.

clue.text: Describe good food shop with pure energy

parts.note: a deli, short for delicatessen, sells fine foods
neat means undiluted, as of spirits
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Describe a fine food shop that runs on pure energy.
explanation.definitionFit: To delineate something is to portray or outline it precisely, which is to describe it.

clue.text: You're welcome? No thanks — unbelievable

parts.note: taken as written
ta is informal British for thanks
a tall story is an unbelievable one

explanation.surface: Someone offered thanks says no thanks, finding it all incredible.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the polite reply to someone's thanks, meaning the favour was no trouble.

clue.text: Mixed bather to be held under water

indicators.note: mixed tells us the letters of bather are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A swimmer in a mixed pool is to be held under the water.
explanation.definitionFit: A swimmer going under holds air in the lungs, so this is what is kept in while submerged.

clue.text: Jethro with oriental fabric

parts.note: Jethro Tull was an English agricultural pioneer, and a rock band named after him
E stands for east, the oriental direction

explanation.surface: Jethro Tull pairs up with some Eastern cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a fine, light netting used for veils and ballet skirts, a kind of cloth.

clue.text: Grave, listener's home

parts.note: an ear is the organ that listens
a nest is a bird's home

explanation.surface: Serious stuff: where a listener lives.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean serious and solemn in manner, the opposite of frivolous.

clue.text: Fruit for fellow with audacity kidnapping Mrs Batty (Last of the Summer Wine)

parts.note: a man is a fellow

indicators.note: kidnapping means the audacity word seizes and holds the woman's name

parts.note: daring means boldness, audacity
Nora Batty is the wrinkled-stockinged character in the long-running British TV comedy Last of the Summer Wine

indicators.note: Last of picks the closing letter of the word Wine

explanation.surface: A fruit for a bold man who carries off Nora Batty from the old TV sitcom.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracket looks like a mere reference for Nora Batty, from the BBC sitcom Last of the Summer Wine, but it also says to take the last letter of Wine. DARING holds NORA to make DARINORANG.
explanation.definitionFit: This citrus is a small loose-skinned type, a tangerine, so it is a fruit.

clue.text: Thackeray's 1 across Mrs, or Mrs Collins, bad girl etc wrongly put outside

definitions.text: Thackeray's 1 across Mrs, or Mrs Collins

indicators.note: put outside means the rearranged letters wrap round the girl word
wrongly means the letters of etc are arranged in a different order

parts.note: a harlot is a promiscuous woman, a bad girl

explanation.surface: A woman from literature, perhaps the wayward one, gets wrongly placed outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrongly' scrambles the three letters of etc, split round the bad girl. Thackeray's comic poem The Sorrows of Werther has her slicing the 1 across food; Mr Collins marries Charlotte Lucas in Pride and Prejudice.
explanation.definitionFit: Charlotte is the heroine of Thackeray's Werther parody and the first name of Mr Collins's wife.

clue.text: Playwright with killer on line

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the killer comes after the line

parts.note: an orca is a killer whale

explanation.surface: A dramatist with a killer whale on the line.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico García Lorca was the Spanish poet and dramatist who wrote Blood Wedding.

clue.text: Report of the Blue Boy?

indicators.note: Report of signals a word that is spoken and heard rather than spelt

parts.note: cyan is a greenish-blue colour

explanation.surface: An account of Gainsborough's famous painting, The Blue Boy.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls Gainsborough's painting The Blue Boy. Collins lists CYAN and SCION with the same pronunciation, sigh-un.
explanation.definitionFit: A scion is a young heir or descendant of a family, so a son or boy.

clue.text: Name given to action relating to property

definitions.meaning: read cryptically, a title applied to a deed, a name given to an act
the legal document proving who owns land or a house

explanation.definitionFit: It is the legal document proving ownership of land or a building, so it concerns property.

clue.text: Pale robe possibly worth putting on table

indicators.note: possibly tells us the letters of pale robe may be rearranged

explanation.surface: A pale robe might be worth laying on the dinner table.
explanation.walkthrough: The table is a surgeon's operating table, not a dining one.
explanation.definitionFit: A patient who can be operated on is fit to go onto the surgeon's table.

clue.text: See 1
Chosen people went on bus with conductor

parts.note: the elect are those chosen, as by God
to ride a bus is to travel on it, so rode

explanation.surface: The chosen few boarded a bus with its ticket collector.
explanation.walkthrough: 'conductor' is not the bus worker but an electrical conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: An electrode is a terminal that carries electric current, an electrical conductor.

clue.text: Gas that should be pure: I flatter to deceive

indicators.note: to deceive suggests the letters of I flatter are played false and rearranged

explanation.surface: A smooth talker admits flattering in order to mislead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gas' looks like idle talk, in keeping with flattery, but here it is a fluid passed through a filter.
explanation.definitionFit: This is fluid, liquid or gas, that has passed through a filter and so ought to be clean.

clue.text: The monkey's mistake

definitions.meaning: a South American monkey known for its loud cries

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a loud-voiced South American primate and a glaring, laughable blunder.

clue.text: 9's suicidal lover — sheep's about right!

indicators.note: about means the sheep word goes round the abbreviation for right

parts.note: a wether is a castrated ram, with the possessive dropped

explanation.surface: Charlotte's tragic admirer is said to be a sheep, and rightly so.
explanation.walkthrough: Goethe's young Werther kills himself for love of Charlotte, the answer at 9.
explanation.definitionFit: Goethe's hero in The Sorrows of Young Werther shoots himself for love of Charlotte.

clue.text: Agape with fish before work in London, say

indicators.note: in means the fish-and-work pair sits inside the city word

parts.note: a wen is a big city; Cobbett called London the Great Wen

indicators.note: before means the fish comes ahead of the work in the run

parts.note: the ide is a freshwater fish
op, short for opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Staring open-mouthed at a fish before going to work in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: London is not a postcode here: Cobbett's 'Great Wen' makes WEN, a big city, which holds IDE and OP.
explanation.definitionFit: Agape means with mouth gaping, open as wide as it goes.

clue.text: Dog keeps Yorkshire river rising with 1 across, say

indicators.note: keeps means the dog word holds the river within it

parts.note: a pug is a small breed of dog

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the river's name reads upwards

parts.note: the Nidd is a river in North Yorkshire

explanation.surface: A dog holds onto a river in Yorkshire going up, alongside some bread and jam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reads the Yorkshire river upwards, as fits a down clue. The definition points to the classic British dessert named after 1 across.
explanation.definitionFit: Coupled with 1 across this names a baked British dessert of buttered slices and custard.

clue.text: Robin loves bugbear

parts.note: Robin Hood, the outlaw of Sherwood
two loves are two zero scores in tennis, O and O

explanation.surface: Robin Hood adores his worst enemy.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoodoo is a jinx or source of bad luck, something feared and dreaded.

clue.text: Weather feature with French gentleman among battle lines?

indicators.note: among means the gentleman's abbreviation goes in among the battle lines

parts.note: a war front is the line where armies clash
M is the abbreviation for monsieur

explanation.surface: A Frenchman caught between the lines of battle during bad weather.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the leading edge of a mass of warmer air on a weather map.

clue.text: Meeting of reactionary spirit

indicators.note: reactionary suggests going back, so the word of is turned round

parts.note: rum is a spirit

explanation.surface: A gathering of right-wing spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A forum is a gathering or assembly for open discussion, a public meeting.

clue.text: Golden solver's French royal family

parts.note: setters call the solver you, and tu is French for you
d'or is French for golden, of gold

explanation.surface: A golden puzzler's French ruling house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French' governs both pieces: TU, you, the solver, and D'OR, of gold.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudors were the English royal dynasty from Henry VII to Elizabeth I.

clue.text: Composer of simple harmonies

indicators.note: of indicates the name is formed from letters within simple harmonies

explanation.surface: A songwriter of uncomplicated tunes.
explanation.walkthrough: Franz Lehár wrote the operetta The Merry Widow.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Lehár was the Hungarian operetta composer of The Merry Widow.

clue.text: Tough goddess shortly keeping a lot of American carnivores

indicators.note: keeping means the shortened goddess holds the trimmed animal word
shortly means the goddess's name is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: Diana is the Roman goddess of the hunt and moon

indicators.note: a lot of means most, but not all, of the animal word's letters are used

parts.note: raccoons are American members of the order Carnivora; raccoon can be a plural

explanation.surface: A hard goddess briefly sheltering a crowd of American predators.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a lot of' keeps RACON from RACCOON, and 'shortly' cuts DIANA to DIAN, which holds it.
explanation.definitionFit: Draconian means extremely harsh or severe, after the strict Athenian lawgiver Draco.

clue.text: More lies fabricated in capital by Tory group

indicators.note: in means the shuffled letters go inside the capital city

parts.note: Prague is the Czech capital

indicators.note: fabricated means the letters of more lies are made up afresh

explanation.surface: More lies made up in the capital by a Conservative organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: The Primrose League was a Victorian Conservative organisation honouring Disraeli.
explanation.definitionFit: This was a Conservative association founded in 1883 in memory of Disraeli, whose favourite flower was the primrose.
